svg.title: KingProgress — connect, choose what you watch, and see every workflow run the moment it starts
svg.desc: A ten second loop: signing in with a token from the clipboard, filtering which runs to watch, and three notification cards sliding in from the right — one passing, one running with a time based progress bar, one failing.

g.text: Watches your GitHub Actions and slides a card
onto your screen the moment one starts.
It watches your workflow runs and shows a
Opens GitHub with repo and workflow already ticked.
KingProgress notices it on your clipboard and signs you in.
Token found on your clipboard — connecting…
Every run in the repositories below shows up.
